from tqdm import tqdm
import numpy as np
import time

def calculate_moving_averages(data_size=1_000_000, window_size=100):
    # Generate random data
    data = np.random.random(data_size)
    moving_averages = np.zeros(data_size - window_size + 1)
    
    # Calculate moving average with progress bar
    for i in tqdm(range(len(moving_averages)), desc="Calculating"):
        # Intentionally using a simple loop instead of numpy's optimized functions
        # to demonstrate tqdm with a ~10 second process
        window_sum = 0
        for j in range(window_size):
            window_sum += data[i + j]
            time.sleep(1e-6)  # Small delay to simulate more processing
        moving_averages[i] = window_sum / window_size
    
    return moving_averages

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("Starting moving average calculation...")
    result = calculate_moving_averages()
    print(f"\nFinished!")
